31924-XVII.s: This bill sets the 2008 slotwet (final budget adjustment) amounts for the Ministry of Youth and Families and allows a pilot deviation from certain Comptabiliteitswet 2001 requirements for its 2008 annual report. It also states that the annual report omits older years since 2008 is the ministry's first budget.
31924-XVII.j: The memorandum justifies the deviations from the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 as necessary for a pilot on the annual report structure.
q: For the purpose of the pilot, it is necessary to deviate for those years from a number of provisions of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 concerning the structure of the annual report.
Ten behoeve van de pilot is het noodzakelijk voor die jaren af te wijken van een aantal bepalingen in de Comptabiliteitswet 2001 met betrekking tot de inrichting van het jaarverslag.

32360-E.s: This bill amends the 2009 budget statement of the Spaarfonds AOW (state savings fund for the old-age pension) by adopting the final budget adjustment (slotwet), with realised figures recorded in thousands of euros. It is a technical budget bill with retroactive effect to 31 December 2009 and contains no delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: The budget statement of the Spaarfonds AOW for the year 2009 is amended as shown in the statement belonging to this act.
Artikel 1 De begrotingsstaat van het Spaarfonds AOW voor het jaar 2009 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

32500-I.s: The bill sets the 2011 budget of the Crown (begroting de Koning) and amends the Comptabiliteitswet 2001 for 2011 so that the Crown's budget can be adopted by separate law, covering constitutional allowances to royal family members and functional expenses of the monarch. It applies from 1 January 2011 with retroactive effect where the gazette is published later.
q: To make that formally possible it is necessary to be able to deviate from articles 1, 8 and 57 of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001.
Om die ook formeel mogelijk te maken dient afgeweken te kunnen worden van de artikelen 1, 8 en 57 van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001.

32500-XVIII.s: This is the 2011 budget bill for the Ministry of Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration, setting the expenditure and revenue estimates for its policy and non-policy articles in thousands of euros. It also fixes the 2011 budget statements for the Rijksgebouwendienst and Huurcommissie operating-cost agencies.
q: The budget statement for Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration (XVIII) for the year 2011 attached to this Act is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van Wonen, Wijken en Integratie (XVIII) voor het jaar 2011 wordt vastgesteld.

32710-F.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget statement of the Animal Health Fund (Diergezondheidsfonds) through a supplementary budget and final budget adjustment, changing article 1 budget lines in thousands of euros. It sets the budget in thousands of euros and provides that the act takes effect the day after publication and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The budget statement of the Animal Health Fund for the year 2010 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.
De begrotingsstaat van het Diergezondheidsfonds voor het jaar 2010 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

33240-G.s: The bill amends the 2011 budget statement (slotwet) of the BTW-compensatiefonds, the VAT compensation fund, to reflect the realised outcome. It sets the amended statement's amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of the VAT compensation fund for the year 2011
Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het BTW-compensatiefonds voor het jaar 2011

33280-C.s: This bill amends the 2012 budget of the provincial fund (provinciefonds), setting revised commitment amounts for the general grant and integration and decentralisation grants and adjusting the budget schedule by 48,107 thousand euro. It enters into force on 1 June 2012 with retroactive effect where publication occurs later.
q: We Beatrix, by the grace of God, Queen of the Netherlands, Princess of Orange-Nassau, etc.
Wij Beatrix, bij de gratie Gods, Koningin der Nederlanden, Prinses van Oranje-Nassau, enz. enz. enz.

33400-I.s: The bill adopts the 2013 state budget (begrotingsstaat) for the Crown (Koning), setting appropriations in thousands of euros for the Crown's grondwettelijke uitkering to royal family members and functional expenditure of the Dienst van het Koninklijk Huis. It takes effect on 1 January 2013, with retroactive effect if the Staatsblad is published later.
q: The budget statement belonging to this act for the year 2013 is established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2013 wordt vastgesteld.

33400-XVIII.s: This bill formally adopts the 2013 budget statement for the Ministry of Housing and Civil Service (Wonen en Rijksdienst), including its expenditure and receipts, and the 2013 budget statements for its business-operation services (baten-lastendiensten). It fixes amounts in thousands of euros and sets entry into force on 1 January 2013 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: The budget statement of Housing and Civil Service attached to this law for the year 2013 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van Wonen en Rijksdienst voor het jaar 2013 wordt vastgesteld.

33480-A.s: The bill amends the 2012 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Infrastructuurfonds by adjusting spending and commitment figures across infrastructure articles, effective from 1 December 2012. It contains no delegation of rule-making power, and the explanatory memorandum concerns budget reallocations and a court ruling on flora and fauna exemptions.
q: Amendment of the 2012 budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund
Wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2012

33605-B.s: This is a supplementary budget bill (slotwet) that amends the 2012 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), adjusting expenditure and revenue figures and fixing the commitment amounts for the general and integration/decentralisation grants. It also sets the entry-into-force rule, making the law effective the day after publication and retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: This concerns a difference of minus € 27,805,000.
Het gaat hierbij om een verschil van – € 27.805.000 (negatief).

33640-C.s: This bill amends the 2013 budget of the Provinciefonds (provincial fund), adjusting expenditure and revenue figures by about 389 million euros and setting commitment amounts for general, integration and decentralisation grants. It enters into force on 1 June 2013 and is accompanied by an explanatory memorandum noting that part of the funds goes to municipalities, provinces and metropolitan regions for implementation costs.
q: The commitment amount referred to in Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general grant and supplementary grants is set at €453,219,000 for grant year 2013.

Het verplichtingenbedrag bedoeld in artikel 5, eerste lid van de Financiële-verhoudingswet terzake van de algemene uitkering c.a. en de aanvullende uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2013 vastgesteld op € 453.219.000.

33750-A.s: This bill establishes the 2014 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Infrastructuurfonds, setting expenditure and revenue figures in thousands of euros and fixing its entry into force. The accompanying explanatory extract covers project budgets, Kustwacht cost tables, and DBFM contract accounting, with no explicit new delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: The budget statement of the Infrastructure Fund for the year 2014 belonging to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het Infrastructuurfonds voor het jaar 2014 wordt vastgesteld.

33930-A.s: This bill is a closing budget amendment (Slotwet) to the 2013 budget of the Infrastructure Fund, adjusting appropriations and expenditures by technical and bookkeeping corrections. It contains no delegation of rule-making power and no new executive discretion.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation changes, bookkeeping changes, or changes arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

33940-XVII.s: This bill amends the 2014 departmental budget statute for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII) by adjusting commitment and expenditure figures across its policy articles. It also sets the effective date of the amendment, with retroactive effect to 1 June 2014 if published later.
q: The present bill aims to make changes for the year 2014 to the departmental budget statute for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII).
Het onderhavige wetsvoorstel strekt ertoe om voor het jaar 2014 wijzigingen aan te brengen in: de departementale begrotingsstaat voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking (XVII)

34200-J.s: This bill amends the 2014 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Deltafonds by adopting the final budget adjustments (slotwetmutaties) in euro thousands, with the amendments taking effect the day after publication and retroactive to 31 December 2014. The explanatory memorandum states that it contains only technical implementation changes, bookkeeping adjustments and changes arising from audit findings.
34200-J.j: The memorandum justifies the amendments as technical implementation changes, bookkeeping changes and changes following audit findings, not as new delegated or executive powers.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation changes, bookkeeping changes or changes arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

34210-I.s: This bill amends the 2015 budget statement of the Royal Household (begroting van de Koning) by an increase of EUR 233 thousand in expenditure and EUR 57 thousand in receipts, effective from 1 June 2015. It contains no delegation of rule-making power to the executive and no new powers; it is a formal budgetary adjustment.
q: The budget statement belonging to the budget of the Royal Household (I) for the year 2015 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
Artikel 1 De begrotingsstaat behorende bij de begroting van de Koning (I) voor het jaar 2015 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

34210-XVIII.s: This bill amends the 2015 budget statements for the Ministry of Housing and Central Government Affairs (XVIII) and for the government agencies, through a first supplementary budget. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force from 1 June 2015 with retroactive effect where publication is later.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of Housing and Central Government Affairs (XVIII) and the budget statement for the agencies, all for the year 2015.

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van Wonen en Rijksdienst (XVIII) en van de begrotingsstaat inzake de agentschappen alle voor het jaar 2015.

34300-I.s: This bill adopts the 2016 budget statute for the Crown (the King's household and functional expenditure), setting expenditure at €40,584 thousand with nil receipts. The explanatory memorandum explains the constitutional allowances to royal family members and the functional costs of the monarchy.
q: The budget statement for the year 2016 attached to this law is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2016 wordt vastgesteld.

34300-XVIII.s: This document is the 2016 budget bill (voorstel van wet) for the Ministry of Housing and Central Government Affairs, setting appropriations and revenues for housing, built environment, civil service and state real estate policy. It establishes the budget statements for the Ministry and its executive agencies, with the explanatory memorandum describing spending plans, agency financing and oversight bodies, but it contains no delegation of rule-making power.
q: Article 1 The budget statement for the year 2016 attached to this law is hereby established.
Artikel 1 De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2016 wordt vastgesteld.

34550-B.s: The bill formally sets the 2017 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) at the amounts stated in article 3, with budget figures in thousands of euros and entry into force on 1 January 2017. The explanatory memorandum excerpts discuss municipal financial positions, OZB property tax caps, cost-sharing for the Waarderingskamer and social domain spending patterns, without shifting power to the executive.
q: The commitment amount in article 5, first paragraph, of the Financial Relations Act for the general grant and supplementary grants is set for the 2017 grant year at € 15,353,258,000.

Het verplichtingenbedrag in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet ter zake van de algemene uitkering c.a. en de aanvullende uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2017 vastgesteld op € 15.353.258.000.

34730-B.s: This first supplementary budget amends the 2017 budget of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), setting the commitment amounts for the general and additional grants and the integration and decentralisation grants, with effect from 1 June 2017. The explanatory memorandum notes small transfer items such as a regional social-employment project in Groningen and the takeover of childcare inspection funding by the Ministry of Social Affairs.
q: The commitment amount referred to in Article 5(1) of the Financial Relations Act for the general grant and additional grants is set at €15,460,522,000 for the 2017 grant year.

Het verplichtingenbedrag bedoeld in artikel 5, eerste lid, van de Financiële-verhoudingswet terzake van de algemene uitkering c.a. en de aanvullende uitkeringen wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2017 vastgesteld op € 15.460.522.000.

35200-I.s: The bill adopts the final budget adjustment (slotwet) for the Royal Household's 2018 budget, changing the budget schedule so that spending and receipts match the realised figures. The explanatory memorandum attributes the lower constitutional allowance expenditure to the collective labour agreement for central government employees, which came in below the earlier estimate.
35200-I.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by the lower-than-expected effect of the collective labour agreement on constitutional allowances.
q: The expenditure change is explained by the effect of the collective labour agreement for the central government sector on constitutional allowances.
De uitgavenmutatie wordt verklaard door de doorwerking van de cao voor de sector Rijk naar de grondwettelijke uitkeringen.

35350-C.s: The bill amends the 2019 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund) through a second supplementary budget, setting the commitment amounts for the general grant and for integration and decentralisation grants. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 1 December 2019.
q: The commitment amount referred to in Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general grant is set for grant year 2019 at €2,146,168,000.
Het verplichtingenbedrag bedoeld in artikel 5, eerste lid van de Financiële-verhoudingswet (Fvw) ter zake van de algemene uitkering wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2019 vastgesteld op € 2.146.168.000.

35450-B.s: This bill amends the 2020 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds), the first supplementary budget, adding about 428 million euros in expenditure and commitments and setting the 2020 commitment amounts for the general grant and the integration and decentralisation grants. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, with retroactive effect to 1 May 2020.
q: The 2020 budget statement of the municipal fund is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this act.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

35470-XVII.s: This bill amends the 2019 budget statement (Slotwet) for the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation, recording final realised amounts against the adjusted budget. It sets the figures in thousands of euros and takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.

35650-XVII.s: This bill amends the 2020 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (second supplementary budget), adjusting commitments, expenditure and receipts across policy articles. It sets the budget figures in thousands of euros and makes the law effective retroactively from 1 December 2020.
q: the need has emerged for an amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation for the year 2020
de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkleingssamenweking voor het jaar 2020

35830-XVII.s: This bill amends the 2020 budget statement (begrotingsstaat) of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation, the so-called slotwet, adjusting authorised commitments, expenditure and revenue across five policy articles. It also sets the amounts in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from the day after publication, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the departmental budget statement of Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (XVII) for the year 2020

Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking (XVII) voor het jaar 2020

36100-I.s: This bill (Slotwet) amends the 2021 departmental budget of the King's household (Koning I), setting final realised expenditure and revenue figures after the first and second supplementary budgets. It also sets the amounts in thousands of euros and the effective date of the act.
q: We, Willem-Alexander, by the grace of God, King of the Netherlands, Prince of Orange-Nassau, etc.
Wij Willem-Alexander, bij de gratie Gods, Koning der Nederlanden, Prins van Oranje-Nassau, enz.

36250-C.s: This bill amends the 2022 budget statement of the provinciefonds (provincial fund), raising the general grant commitment to €2,757,786,000 and setting integration and decentralisation grant commitments at €0 and €75,557,000. It takes effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad, retroactively from 1 December 2022.
q: The commitment amount referred to in Article 5(1) of the Financiële-verhoudingswet for the general grant for grant year 2022 is changed to €2,757,786,000.
Het verplichtingenbedrag bedoeld in artikel 5, eerste lid van de Financiële-verhoudingswet (Fvw) ter zake van de algemene uitkering wordt voor het uitkeringsjaar 2022 gewijzigd in € 2.757.786.000.

36350-B.s: This bill amends the 2023 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) by a first supplementary budget, adding about 883 million euros to expenditure and about 1.54 billion euros to receipts. It also fixes the 2023 commitment amounts for the general and supplementary grants, integration grants and decentralisation grants paid to municipalities.
q: The budget statement of the municipal fund for the year 2023 is amended, as shown in the statement attached to this law.
De begrotingsstaat van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2023 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

36360-A.s: This bill amends the 2022 departmental budget statement of the Mobility Fund (A) through a final budget adjustment (Slotwet), recording commitments, expenditures and receipts per article. The explanatory memorandum notes that only technical implementation, bookkeeping and audit-related changes are included, with budget changes explained for certain items such as ERTMS and project budgets.
q: This bill includes only technical implementation changes, bookkeeping changes, or changes arising from audit findings.
– In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevin dingen opgenomen;

36550-XVII.s: This bill amends the 2024 budget statement for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (first supplementary budget), raising commitments and expenditure across policy articles and shifting amounts between items. It takes effect the day after publication and is backdated to 1 June 2024.
36550-XVII.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by the need for extra funding for CSDDD oversight of due diligence rules and for new embassy programmes, without any delegation of new powers.
q: In the first supplementary budget 2024, commitments under article 1 are increased, among others to carry out supervision of the IMVO legislation (CSDDD directive) and for new embassy programmes.

In de eerste suppletoire begroting 2024 worden de verplichtingen op artikel 1 verhoogd o.a. voor het uitvoeren van het toezicht op de IMVO-wetgeving (CSDDD richtlijn) en voor nieuwe programma's bij de ambassades.

36587-(R2197).s: The bill amends the Paspoortwet so that the Dutch identity card no longer shows the holder's sex. It also stops an identity card from lapsing automatically after a change of sex, except for cards that still show the sex.
q: Omitting sex from the Dutch identity card has no consequences for citizens in most cases.
Het weglaten van het geslacht op de Nederlandse identiteitskaart heeft in de meeste gevallen geen gevolgen voor burgers.

parties: Supports removing unnecessary sex registration to protect privacy and data minimisation, asking whether the government can confirm the registration is unnecessary for identification.
These members also believe that removing sex registration from identity cards fits the aim of reducing regulatory burden and unnecessary administration.
Deze leden zijn daarnaast van mening dat het schrappen van geslachtsregistratie op identiteitskaarten past bij het streven om regeldruk en onnodige administratie te beperken.
Asks questions about the practical effect on passenger entry and the risk of refused access to other countries after the sex field becomes unspecified.
What does this mean in practice for the entry of passengers?
Wat betekent dit in de praktijk voor de binnenkomst van passagiers?
Demands a full accounting of costs and consequences and asks the government to show which problems the bill solves and on what evidence, relying on the Panteia study and Raad van State advice.
The NSC members do not yet see which problems this bill will actually solve.
De leden van NSC-fractie zien nog niet in welke problemen dit wetsvoorstel daadwerkelijk zal gaan oplossen.
Strongly supports the bill as a limit on unnecessary data registration to protect citizens' privacy, while asking whether the school enrolment obligation could be dropped.
These members believe unnecessary data registration should be pushed back as far as possible.
Deze leden zijn van mening dat onnodige gegevensregistratie zo veel mogelijk moet worden teruggedrongen.
Asks about the recognition of the new identity card by Turkey and Moldova, the link to the rainbow coalition agreement, and burdens on mbo students who lack passports.
These members are worried about this group of mbo students and pupils.
Deze leden maken zich zorgen om deze groep mbo-studenten en scholieren.
Supports preventing unnecessary sex registration but worries about costs for citizens needing extracts and asks why school enrolment needs the sex data at all.
Says the government has not sufficiently analysed consequences beyond a limited set of situations, calls the justification ideological, and asks why the bill is not withdrawn.
They note, however, that the government still does not make sufficiently clear what the possible consequences of omitting sex registration on the identity card are.
Zij constateren echter dat de regering nog onvoldoende duidelijk maakt wat de mogelijke consequenties zijn van het weglaten van de geslachtsregistratie op de identiteitskaart
Questions the justification, asks for empirical support for claims about stereotypes, and raises possible effects on women's safety and the use of sex as a legitimate distinction.
They therefore ask the government to justify this claim in more detail and substantiate it empirically.
Zij vragen de regering daarom deze stellingname nader en gedegen te motiveren en empirisch te onderbouwen.
Asks how confusion between sex and gender will be managed, whether public information and an evaluation will follow, and how competing group interests will be balanced.
How will the government deal with this and what measures will be taken to adequately inform society
Hoe zal de regering hiermee omgaan en welke maatregelen worden genomen om de samenleving voldoende voor te lichten
Asks about the government's underlying vision, security risks, the inconsistency with the passport retaining sex markers, and whether citizens can demand a matching Curaçao sédula.
The sex marker does remain in our passport.
Geslachtsvermelding blijft wel in ons paspoort.
Opposes the bill, arguing official documents must allow determining a person's original sex and that the change could create unfair situations, such as in sports.
for official documents there must be a way to establish what sex a person originally was.
ten aanzien van officiële documenten moet er een manier zijn om te kunnen achterhalen, van welk geslacht een persoon oorspronkelijk is.
Asks how the civil registry should handle a Dutch citizen living on Curaçao who needs a new passport or NIK without a sex marker, and what instructions the Gevolmachtigde Minister received.
How should the Civil Registry handle this?
Hoe moet de Burgerlijke Stand hiermee te werk gaan?

Warns that dropping sex from identification weakens identification, questions the €2.1 million cost estimate, asks about fraud and nationality loss, and raises the consultation outcome and the national internet consultation.
Once a person's sex is removed, sex becomes irrelevant for identifying a person.
Op het moment dat het geslacht van iemand geschrapt wordt, wordt het geslacht irrelevant om een persoon te identificeren.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised that the explanatory memorandum to the bill removing sex from the Dutch identity card should better explain whether the sex entry can be dispensed with, what existing legal obligations to show a document with sex exist (notably in education enrolment), and what alternatives and financial costs citizens face. The government's nader rapport accepted this and supplemented the memorandum with the requested information on citizens' costs, such as obtaining a BRP extract at about €15–25.
concerns: The explanatory memorandum insufficiently addressed whether the sex entry on the identity card can be dispensed with and what legal obligations citizens face to show documents listing sex, so it should be expanded.
The Afdeling asked for alternatives available to citizens for education enrolment and their financial consequences, which the government added to the memorandum.

36613-XVII.s: This bill amends the 2024 budget statement for Foreign Trade and Development Assistance, raising total expenditure and commitments across policy articles. It also sets the budget in thousands of euros and gives the amended budget retroactive effect to 17 September 2024.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement for Foreign Trade and Development Assistance for the year 2024
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingshulp voor het jaar 2024

36800-B.s: This bill sets the 2026 budget statement of the municipal fund (gemeentefonds) at €47.5 billion and fixes the commitment amounts for the general grant and the integration and decentralisation grants. It enters into force on 1 January 2026, or retroactively if published later.
q: The budget statement of the municipal fund attached to this law for the year 2026 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende begrotingsstaat van het gemeentefonds voor het jaar 2026 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State advised on 8 September 2025 that it had no remarks on the draft 2026 budget bill for the Gemeentefonds and recommended submitting it to the Tweede Kamer. The Minister of Finance's reply of 15 September 2025 notes that the government adjusted the figures for the 2026 accres tranche and the BCF ceiling, raising the total to €47.525.903.000 from €45.668.172.000.

36800-XXII.s: This bill establishes the 2026 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of Housing and Spatial Planning and the agency budget statement for the Rijksvastgoedbedrijf and the Dienst van de Huurcommissie, in thousands of euros. It also includes budget mutation tables and explanatory notes on housing subsidies, spatial planning and building regulation changes.
q: The departmental budget statement belonging to this law for the year 2026 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2026 wordt vastgesteld.
d: entry into force by date of Staatsblad publication

v.summary: The Raad van State's Afdeling advisering issued a blanket advisory opinion on the 2026 budget bill for the Ministry of Housing and Spatial Planning (XXII), raising no remarks and advising submission to the Tweede Kamer. The accompanying nader rapport from the Minister of Finance, on behalf of the Minister of Housing, notes that some budgets require amendments and refers to annexes.

36820-XVII.s: This bill amends the 2025 budget statement for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation (Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingshulp, article XVII) through a supplementary budget, adjusting spending and commitments across five policy articles and setting the amounts in thousands of euros. It is retroactive to 16 September 2025 and contains no delegation of rule-making power to the executive.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation for the year 2025
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingshulp voor het jaar 2025
